edges.notes: libstdc++ is built and released as part of the GNU Compiler Collection; g++ links it by default.
On GNU/Linux with glibc, libstdc++ relies on the C library for many POSIX and low-level services.
Alpine and other musl-based systems ship g++ builds that link libstdc++ atop musl.
GNU ld links libstdc++.so into g++-produced executables and shared libraries on typical flows.
libstdc++ is packaged as ELF shared objects and archives on Unix-class GNU/Linux targets.
Debug builds emit DWARF describing C++ types and inline frames alongside libstdc++ symbols.
C++ interop and extern C boundaries tie C++ standard library use to C ABI and headers.
Clang may link against libstdc++ when configured with -stdlib=libstdc++ on Linux.
GDB debugs C++ programs using libstdc++ containers and symbols with appropriate debug info.
LLDB can debug binaries linked against libstdc++ when debugging Linux C++ toolchains.
GCC ships libstdc++ for supported targets including RISC-V GNU/Linux alongside the C library port.
Substitutable C++ standard library implementations in Clang/GCC-centric toolchain flows (libstdc++ vs libc++).
Substitutable C++ standard library implementations across platforms (GNU libstdc++ vs MSVC msvcp*.dll on Windows).
Debian packages ship g++ builds that link GNU libstdc++ above glibc on typical GNU/Linux flows.
Ubuntu packages ship g++ builds that link GNU libstdc++ above glibc on typical GNU/Linux flows.
Fedora packages ship g++ builds that link GNU libstdc++ above glibc on typical GNU/Linux flows.

CentOS Stream packages ship g++ builds that link GNU libstdc++ above glibc on typical GNU/Linux flows.
Historical CentOS Linux packages shipped g++ builds that link GNU libstdc++ above glibc on typical GNU/Linux flows.
g++ builds on FreeBSD typically link GNU libstdc++ above FreeBSD libc in ports and base toolchains.
g++ builds on OpenBSD can link GNU libstdc++ above OpenBSD libc where GCC/libstdc++ packages are used.
g++ builds on NetBSD can link GNU libstdc++ above NetBSD libc where GCC/libstdc++ packages are used.
g++ builds on DragonFly can link GNU libstdc++ above DragonFly libc where GCC/libstdc++ packages are used.
g++ builds on illumos distributions can link GNU libstdc++ above illumos libc where GCC/libstdc++ packages are used.
Rare g++-oriented native builds may link GNU libstdc++ above Bionic where such toolchains are configured; NDK defaults to libc++.
Embedded g++ toolchains may link GNU libstdc++ above newlib in bare-metal or RTOS flows when enabled.
Experimental or vendor wasm triplets may layer libstdc++ above wasi-libc when sysroots align.
Embedded Linux g++ toolchains may link GNU libstdc++ above uClibc when sysroots align.
Experimental minimal Linux g++ stacks may layer libstdc++ above dietlibc when sysroots align.
